description: This file defines the class Zend_Http_UserAgent_Checker, which extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop, and provides functionality to identify specific user agents (browsers or bots) based on signatures, primarily for detecting bots like 'checker' and related signatures.

classes.name: Zend_Http_UserAgent_Checker
classes.description: A class that extends Zend_Http_UserAgent_Desktop to match user agent strings against a set of signatures to identify bots or specific user agents.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the provided user agent matches any of the predefined signatures.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of user agent, in this case, 'bot'.
